title: CVE-2018-14634: Linux Kernel Integer Overflow Vulnerability
summary: Linux Kernel contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the create_elf_tables() function which could allow an unprivileged local user with access to SUID (or otherwise privileged) binary to escalate their privileges on the system.

title: CVE-2025-52691: SmarterTools SmarterMail Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability

summary: SmarterTools SmarterMail contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the password reset API. The force-reset-password endpoint permits anonymous requests and fails to verify the existing password or a reset token when resetting system administrator accounts.

title: CVE-2024-37079: Broadcom VMware vCenter Server Out-of-bounds Write Vulnerability
summary: Broadcom VMware vCenter Server contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This could allow a malicious actor with network access to vCenter Server to send specially crafted network packets, potentially leading to remote code execution.

title: CVE-2025-68645: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) PHP Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a PHP remote file inclusion vulnerability that could allow for remote attackers to craft requests to the /h/rest endpoint to influence internal request dispatching, allowing inclusion of arbitrary files from the WebRoot directory.

title: CVE-2025-34026: Versa Concerto Improper Authentication Vulnerability
summary: Versa Concerto SD-WAN orchestration platform contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the Traefik reverse proxy configuration, allowing at attacker to access administrative endpoints. The internal Actuator endpoint can be leveraged for access to heap dumps and trace logs.

title: CVE-2025-31125: Vite Vitejs Improper Access Control Vulnerability
summary: Vite Vitejs contains an improper access control vulnerability that exposes content of non-allowed files using ?inline&import or ?raw?import. Only apps explicitly exposing the Vite dev server to the network (using --host or server.host config option) are affected.

title: CVE-2025-54313: Prettier eslint-config-prettier Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
summary: Prettier eslint-config-prettier contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability. Installing an affected package executes an install.js file that launches the node-gyp.dll malware on Windows.

title: CVE-2025-8110: Gogs Path Traversal Vulnerability
summary: Gogs contains a path traversal vulnerability affecting improper Symbolic link handling in the PutContents API that could allow for code execution.

title: CVE-2009-0556: Microsoft Office PowerPoint Code Injection Vulnerability

Supreme Court: Klein v. Martin
summary: Because the Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit affirmed the award of a new trial based on reasoning that departed from the strict standards that govern the grant of federal habeas relief to prisoners convicted in state court prescribed by the Antiterrorism and Effective Death Penalty Act of 1996, the Court grants the State’s petition for a writ of certiorari and reverses the judgment below. (No. 25-51, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 607 U.S. 213).

title: Supreme Court: Berk v. Choy
summary: Delaware law requiring a plaintiff suing for medical malpractice to provide an affidavit from a medical professional attesting to the suit’s merit, Del. Code, Tit. 18, §6853(a)(1), conflicts with a valid Federal Rule of Civil Procedure and does not apply in federal court. (No. 24-440, opinion by Justice Barrett; 607 U.S. 187).

title: Supreme Court: Ellingburg v. United States
summary: Restitution under the Mandatory Victims Restitution Act of 1996 is criminal punishment for purposes of the Ex Post Facto Clause. (No. 24-482, opinion by Justice Kavanaugh; 607 U.S. 163).

title: Supreme Court: Coney Island Auto Parts Unlimited, Inc. v. Burton
summary: Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 60(c)(1)’s reasonable-time limit applies to a motion alleging that a judgment is void under Rule 60(b)(4). (No. 24-808, opinion by Justice Alito; 607 U.S. 155).

title: Supreme Court: Barrett v. United States
summary: Congress did not clearly authorize convictions under both 18 U. S. C. §§924(c)(1)(A)(i) and (j) for a single act that violates both provisions—therefore, one act that violates both may spawn only one conviction; the part of the Second Circuit’s judgment that held otherwise is reversed. (No. 24-5774, opinion by Justice Jackson; 607 U.S. 128).

title: Supreme Court: Case v. Montana
summary: Under the standard set in Brigham City v. Stuart, 547 U. S. 398, 400, the Fourth Amendment allows police officers to enter a home without a warrant if they have an “objectively reasonable basis for believing” that someone inside needs emergency assistance; that standard was met here. (No. 24-624, opinion by Justice Kagan; 607 U.S. 107).

title: Supreme Court: Bost v. Illinois Bd. of Elections
summary: As a candidate for office, Congressman Bost has standing to challenge the rules that govern the counting of votes in his election. (No. 24-568, opinion by Chief Justice Roberts; 607 U.S. 71).

title: Supreme Court: Bowe v. United States
summary: Title 28 U. S. C. §2244(b)(3)(E) does not bar this Court’s review of a federal prisoner’s request to file a second or successive §2255 motion for postconviction relief, and §2244(b)(1) does not apply to second or successive motions filed under §2255(h) by federal prisoners challenging their convictions or sentences. (No. 24-5438, opinion by Justice Sotomayor; 607 U.S. 13).
